components.name: Tula
components.description: An open-source patient-agent runtime that stores the patient's longitudinal health record locally in FHIR R4 and pulls records via SMART on FHIR.
components.testPatient: Dylan Meyer (synthetic, 51). Essential hypertension, prediabetes, hyperlipidemia. Lisinopril 10 mg. Penicillin allergy. Seasonal influenza, COVID-19, and Tdap. No insurance card.
components.notes: Insurance items are returned unavailable (Tula policy: health data only). Opened directly, the page is a landing page; a Verifier must window.open it.
